# Fantastech Energy Solution LLC

> Solar, battery backup and off-grid power systems for homes, farms and shops in northern Indiana. Sold, sized and installed by the same people. 3645 S 1200 W, Goshen, IN 46528. 574-218-1973. derek@fantastech.org. Hours Mon-Fri 7:00 AM-3:00 PM, Saturday by appointment. Installs in Elkhart, LaGrange, Noble and Kosciusko counties; equipment ships nationwide. English and Pennsylvania Dutch spoken. BBB A+ Accredited. Founded May 2021.

## What we do
- Off-grid solar system design and installation, sized to the customer's real loads (well pumps, barn fans, shop tools, the house)
- Solar battery backup for homes, farms and shops
- Agricultural solar: barns, irrigation and livestock pumps, poultry houses
- Solar refrigerators and chest freezers
- Wholesale solar equipment for installers and dealers (entry wholesale, wholesale and distributor pricing)

## Product lines
- [Solar inverters](https://fantastechenergy.com/solar-inverters.html): hybrid and off-grid inverters from Sol-Ark, Koor, EG4, SRNE and Growatt; Victron charge controllers; EG4 Chargeverter battery charger
- [Lithium solar batteries](https://fantastechenergy.com/solar-batteries.html): LiFePO4 batteries from Koor, Pytes and EG4; 12 V, 24 V and 48 V; rack, wall-mount and stackable; up to 16 kWh per unit
- [Solar panels](https://fantastechenergy.com/solar-panels.html): bifacial panels 585-630 W from Trina, Sunpal, Boviet and Waaree, by the piece, pallet or container
- [Solar freezers and refrigerators](https://fantastechenergy.com/solar-freezers-refrigerators.html): Sunstar chest freezers and refrigerators, 12/24 V DC or 120 V AC
- [Solar well pumps](https://fantastechenergy.com/solar-well-pumps.html): Grundfos SQ submersible pumps with the solar and battery system to run them
- [Racking, PV wire and battery cable](https://fantastechenergy.com/racking-wire.html): Sinclair ground mounts, K2 roof racking, PV wire, battery cable by the foot, lugs, MidNite surge protection
- [Koor](https://koorusa.com/): Fantastech's house brand of inverters and 16 kWh batteries
